responses.text: Ah, the outsider who gained our master's favor. You prove yourself as cunning as the rumors report.
I cannot speak long, for my men need direction. What do you want?
My men await in the tunnel below. I am to divide them between the dam top and the tunnels that lead to the western power plant.

topics.prompt: Report, centurion. What are your standing orders?

responses.text: The fighting in the power plant is the fiercest, as expected. But the dogs have been caught off guard, and their positions can expect no support.
However, the pipes below have been sealed, cutting off our men until the dam top can be secured.
I've been diverting half of my men to the tower next to this one. It's a bit of a swim, but the enemy hasn't sealed those pipes yet.
Some of the other centuriae are more stubborn in following their orders exactly, though, and wait in the pipes below.
If you should make it down there, unsealing the pipes again will allow us to spill over the enemy like a tide of blood.

topics.prompt: What news of the battle below?

responses.text: More than a few, if I have my way.

topics.prompt: I have to keep moving. Kill a few of them for me.

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] Your words have merit... Very well. I shall tell my men to concentrate their efforts here.

topics.prompt: It is imperative we secure the dam top. Instead of dividing your men, focus their attack here.
topics.label: {Speech 60 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men to the dam top}

responses.text: [FAILED] I have my orders, and they explicitly state that I am to divide my men.

topics.prompt: Screw that. I need all your men dying fo- er, backing me up here.
topics.label: {Speech 60 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men to the dam top}

responses.text: [SUCCEEDED] Agreed. If we take the power plant, this battle is over. I'll have my men focus their efforts there. May the Son of Mars go with you.

topics.prompt: The power plant is what really matters. Have all of your men attack there. I'll finish things here.
topics.label: {Speech 80 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men down to the power plant}

responses.text: [FAILED] Forgive my appraisal of your prowess, but all the same I'd rather send some of my men with you to help secure the dam top.

topics.prompt: Pffft. I can handle things here. You and your men can hold the power plant until I get there.
topics.label: {Speech 80 - Convince the centurion to direct all his men down to the power plant}

responses.text: There's still more killing to be done!
